name: Ind Bank Housing Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Ind Bank Housing Ltd 
is in the business of providing Housing Loans[1]
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1][2][3]
Company has suspended making fresh 
lending since 2000 and is in the process 
of recovery of Non-Performing Assets from its borrowers and other loans which 
are under litigation. 
In view of accumulated financial loss, the compliances with the Capital Adequacy, Net Owned Funds, and other related requirements under The National Housing Bank Act, including Housing Finance Companies (NHB) Directions, could not be complied with. Company was given time till June 30, 2022, for attaining a minimum NOF of ~Rs.10 Crore and also for fulfilling Principal Business Criteria (PBC) for housing finance companies. Further, in July 2022, company sent a letter with a copy of the proposed revival plan to RBI and requested a personal hearing. 
At present, company is making continuous 
efforts to recover the non-performing 
assets as was done in the previous financial years. In FY22, company recovered~Rs.3.25 lakhs from individual housing loans and ICD loan vs Rs. 6.00 lakhs in FY21

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -11.0% over past five years.
